Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Atlassian, Sydney

About the team: Our Developer Experience team builds internal tools used by 5,000+ engineers.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain web applications using React, TypeScript and Node.js
- Design REST APIs and work with PostgreSQL and AWS (Lambda, S3, RDS)
- Containerise services with Docker and deploy via CI/CD pipelines
- Collaborate with product managers and designers; write clean, tested code

Requirements:
- 1-3 years of software engineering experience or a strong project portfolio
- Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python
- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS)
- Strong communication and ownership

Nice to have: experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines or ML integration.
